name: Sequestrion
source:
Welcome to Sequestrion.

We serve the population as guarantors of security.  Granted - If you have nothing to hide.

Sequestrion is a Visual Novel that focuses on the lives of its employees. It's business as usual until Ether and their coworker, Tessera, start to have odd encounters...

[From [url=https://ricecrow.itch.io/sequestrion]Itch.io[/url]]
